gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab reads as a classic serif, dignified and tightly knit between its lowercase and caps. Delius Unicase, relaxed and handwritten, keeps every curve at full thickness and feels comfortable company for a few paragraphs.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-prompt: Delius Unicase draws its handwritten curves without ever thinning at the turns, giving the headings a soft, rope-like friendliness. Prompt, a sans with oversized small letters, follows quietly.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-montserrat: Relaxed and inviting, Delius Unicase hums along. Its handwritten, unthinning strokes are best at greeting you, while Montserrat, a sans with wide, spacious curves, glides the eye through the lines that follow.
gen-gf-domine-general-sans: General Sans sets a sans body with a steady pen pressure and a tall x-height, under Domine's literary, gently thickened curves. The unlikely friendship is a bookish voice meeting a modern one.
gen-gf-edu-au-vic-wa-nt-hand-fs-literata: Edu AU VIC WA NT Hand writes graceful, inviting letters with no tapering at the ends, sitting low beneath its capitals. Literata, a classic serif with gently swelling rounds, keeps a longer read bookish and smooth.
gen-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-fs-literata: Tiny lowercase shapes tuck beneath tall capitals, like quick handwriting. Edu VIC WA NT Hand earns its keep big and brief, while Literata, a sophisticated serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, carries the sentences below.
gen-gf-esteban-general-sans: Bookish and refined, with a tall middle zone. Esteban's moderate contrast carries the heading, and General Sans follows in a sans-serif with a smooth path around every bend, so a long page keeps moving.
gen-gf-fanwood-text-general-sans: Editorial and classic, Fanwood Text has short-looking ascenders and slightly thinner joins where curves meet stems, while General Sans is tubular and wire-like. One brings a bookish tone, the other a sans with a tall x-height.
gen-gf-finger-paint-fs-ranade: Ranade spreads its stroke ends far apart, with only a slight shift in weight along each curve. Finger Paint's tall bodies and chunky crossbars give the pair a bold voice.
gen-gf-finger-paint-rubik: Finger Paint's bodies are so tall its capitals barely rise above them, and its curves stay thick. Rubik softens that with big lowercase and open round letters, a sans-serif that reads clearly beside the loudness.
